title: View from the ship's porthole of a fiery planet and boxes being loaded

tellings.quote: there was something like a fiery well like a planet giving off heat. And from there they were taking out some kind of cylinders or maybe not cylinders, more like boxes. They were loading those into the ship.

plain: A former president of a Russian republic named Kiran Ilum Xenov says that when he was taken aboard an alien ship in 1997, he looked out of a porthole and saw something like a fiery planet giving off heat. He says, telling it as his own experience, that beings were taking out cylinders, or more like boxes, from there and loading them into the ship.
